view.title: Community Radar
set.folderDesc: Notes for the plugins you track are created here.
set.notBuilt: Not downloaded yet; it comes with the next sync.
set.needsKeychain: Translation needs Obsidian 1.11.4 or later to keep the API key in Obsidian's keychain.
set.keyDesc: Pick from Obsidian's keychain or add a new one. Suggested name: {name} — plugins using the same name share the key.
set.thinkingDesc: Off: the model answers without thinking first. Thinking is billed as output and is most of a translation's cost; translating rarely needs it, so off is usually several times cheaper and faster.
set.thinking.mandatory: This model always thinks; it can't be turned off. Pick another model to turn it off.
set.thinking.none: This model doesn't think: nothing to turn off.
set.thinking.elsewhere: Here the model thinks as it does by default; this plugin can turn thinking off through OpenRouter only. To turn it off, pick the same model on OpenRouter.
set.modelHint: Type to filter; names that aren't listed (e.g. ~google/gemini-flash-latest on OpenRouter) can be used as typed.
set.noPrices: This provider's model list has no prices.
set.routeDesc: Balanced: OpenRouter weighs the price actually paid, speed and reliability. Cheapest / Fastest skip that; with Thinking off, providers that must think are left out. Picker prices are list prices; what you paid shows after each request.
set.usageDesc: What each model has used so far. Cost is shown where the provider reports it (OpenRouter).
set.usageResetDesc: Every model's requests, tokens and cost go, and the estimates start again from the price list until a model has made a few requests of each kind.
set.savedDesc: {n} short descriptions · {o} Overviews. Delete removes the short descriptions only (they're translated again, and billed); Overview translations are kept.
set.deleteDesc: They're translated again when you ask, and billed again. Overview translations stay.
set.supportDesc: Community Radar is free. If it saves you time, you can support its development.
readme.failed: _Couldn't fetch the README. Try “Update README of this note” from the command palette._
error.noJsonArray: No JSON array in the translation reply.
error.emptyText: The reply has an empty translation.
error.truncated: The reply was cut short (the model ran out of room).
error.profileMissing: Couldn't download the plugin's profile. Check your connection and try again.
error.noKey: Pick or add the API key named “{name}” first.
set.languageDesc: Auto follows Obsidian's language. Command names change after Obsidian restarts.
set.syncHoursDesc: Downloads the catalog, adds new release history and updates tracking notes. Nothing is downloaded between syncs.
set.readmeModeDesc: When a tracked plugin has a new release, the README in its note is refreshed:
set.baseDesc: Puts the {path} table back to the default template. Any changes you made in that file are lost.
notice.baseReset: Community Radar: {path} reset to the template
cmd.base: Create or reset the Bases view
filter.toggleOn: Filter on — click to show all
search.regex: Regular expression: /…/ searches the id, name, author and description
groups.none: No group yet — pick one below or type a new one.
groups.aiSetup: For AI suggestions, pick a provider, an API key and a model in Settings → Community Radar → AI.
groups.hint: Click a chip to switch it on or off.
batch.legend: one of your groups; the others are new
batch.none: Every tracked plugin already has a group.

notice.groupsMigrated.one: Community Radar: {n} note moved from `group` to the `groups` list.
notice.groupsMigrated.other: Community Radar: {n} notes moved from `group` to the `groups` list.

similar.none: No list yet: a newly listed plugin gets its similar plugins within a day.
error.noJsonObject: No JSON object in the AI reply.
rating.label: {n} of 5
keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.ignore: don't show again · in Hidden: restore
keys.translate: translate the description / hide it (details: with the Overview; on the README tab, the README)
set.translatedFirstDesc: Descriptions, Overviews and READMEs show in your language wherever a translation is kept; the rest in the original. A row's language chip (until Obsidian restarts) and the details window's Original | your language (while it's open) still switch them one at a time.
notice.translateRejected: {model} didn't translate it (it sent back the original or another language), so nothing was kept. Try another model with ⋯ › Translate again…
menu.retranslateTip: The description and the Overview, made again with a model you pick, when a translation reads badly. A reply that doesn't translate keeps the old one.
menu.retranslateReadmeTip: The README, translated again with a model you pick, when its translation reads badly.
keys.readme: open the README in your note
set.keyboardDesc: While the Community Radar tab is active, j / k move the highlight and single letters act on that row. The ⌨ icon in the filter bar lists them.
set.motionDesc: Effects such as the ring around a text being translated, the Home page's entrances and the selection bar's spinner. System follows your operating system's reduce-motion setting; On and Off override it.
set.translateFxDesc: How the details window shows a text while the AI translates it: the text stays where it is, and this effect plays over it until the translation arrives.
row.stale: ↪ left this list · stays until you reopen the view
set.statusDesc: Gives tracked plugins a status of your own. When off, the status chip and filter are hidden; the values in your notes stay.
set.statusAddDesc: Start with an emoji if you like, e.g. 📚 Reading the docs.

notice.statusMigrated.one: Community Radar: {n} note's status moved to the new statuses.
notice.statusMigrated.other: Community Radar: {n} notes' statuses moved to the new statuses.

similar.how: by description, AI overview, category and tags · built on GitHub, no AI request
layout.label: Layout
details.removed: Taken off the official list on {date}: {reason}
details.noHistory: No releases in the history yet.
details.notTranslated: There's no {lang} translation of this README yet.
details.infoTranslationTip: As the AI provider reported it · translated {date}
details.outdatedNote: The README has changed since this translation.
cmd.readmeTranslate: Translate the README of this note
set.notesHeadingDesc: Heading above your own notes in new tracking notes. Empty: “My notes” in the interface language. Existing notes stay as they are.
set.readmeTranslationDesc: Only when you ask: translates the plugin's GitHub README into your target language. It's kept in the plugin's note, above the original; for a plugin you don't track, in the plugin's cache.
set.readmeSavingDesc: Leaves sections for developers (installing, building, contributing, licence, privacy, support…) out of the translation, so you pay only for what you'll read. The end of the translation lists what was left out.
set.aiGroupsDesc: The group window asks the AI for groups that fit the plugin, and the selection bar offers Group with AI. Turn it off and no group request is sent: the ★ still marks the closest of your groups from similar plugins.
row.hatchedTip: It came out of a {n}-day pause between update waves: no release in that time.
set.newDaysDesc: How many days a plugin keeps its New badge after it's listed (default: 14). The New tab's query (`listed <= 14d`) uses the same period.
cmd.similarCurrent: Show plugins similar to this note's plugin
filter.tipNone: Filters: none changed from this tab's defaults
notice.historyServer: Release history ready: {from} – {to}, built daily on GitHub.
set.historyDesc: {from} → {to}, built daily on GitHub from Obsidian's stats and downloaded with each sync.
notice.historyFailed: Couldn't download the release history. Check your connection and try again.

filter.queryNote: Query mode is active: the download threshold, extra filters, and sorting are controlled by the query.
query.error.unknown: there's no field “{text}”; to search text, write "{text}" or text ~ {text}

query.replaceHint: Replaces this page's own query; Settings ↺ brings the default back.

gallery.section.notify.hint: Hear about plugins that just came in
gallery.section.track.hint: Tidy up your tracked plugins and notes
gallery.own: Can't find what you're looking for? Write your own query and save it as a view.
preset.month.desc: Released since the 1st; the most downloaded first.
preset.month.why: For a monthly sweep, and to see the date functions at work.
preset.fast.desc: Listed in the last 2 months and already past 1K downloads.
preset.fast.why: New plugins adopted quickly; likely to last.
preset.gems.desc: 1K–10K downloads, updated this month and grown by 20% or more.
preset.gems.why: Good work in the shadow of the big plugins.
preset.awake.desc: Released this month after at least 6 months of silence (incubation).
preset.awake.why: Maintenance has restarted; a good moment to return to an old need.
preset.popular.desc: 50K+ downloads and updated in the last 14 days.
preset.popular.why: Important changes that reach many people.
preset.milestones.desc: Passed 10K downloads in the last 30 days, whatever they have now.
preset.milestones.why: Plugins proving themselves; write any other count you watch instead of 10k.
preset.active.desc: 1K+ downloads and 3+ updates in the last 30 days; the fastest growing first.
preset.active.why: Lively projects their developer is focused on right now.
preset.stale.desc: Installed in this vault and not updated for 1+ year; the oldest first.
preset.stale.why: A compatibility risk: look for an alternative or clean up the vault.
preset.totry.desc: Plugins you track but haven't installed in this vault.
preset.totry.why: Your personal try-out list, sorted by your rating.
preset.ungrouped.desc: Tracked plugins not in any group yet.
preset.unrated.desc: Plugins you track but haven't rated yet.
preset.unrated.why: Your review queue; the most downloaded first.
preset.sleeping.desc: On your list but no new release for 1+ year.
preset.sleeping.why: To check whether they're still worth following.
hidden.title: Hidden ({n})
set.startDesc: Whether Community Radar opens on Home or where you left off. Home's ⋮ menu changes it too.
set.hidden.excluded: Plugins you took off every list.
set.hidden.snoozed: They come back by themselves with their next release.
set.hidden.dismissed: Taken off Suggested only; other lists still show them.
home.new.info: Just joined the directory: discover them before everyone else. Last {days} days, newest first.
home.awakened.info: Back from a long silence: plugins that waited at least {incubated} days, then shipped again. A tool you gave up on may be back.
home.updated.info: Really updated: plugins you don't track with a release in the last {days} days. The ones releasing more often than every three weeks are left out.
home.suggested.info: Installed in this vault but not tracked: track them so you never miss an update.
query.pageReset: “{name}” is back to its default query.
query.field.removed: taken off the official list (shown only if installed)
query.error.param: “{field}” takes a parameter: write {field}() for its default, or e.g. {field}(30d)
home.mine.info: Your list: rate, group and take notes, so you always remember what you use and why.
home.hidden.info: What you set aside: hid something by mistake? Bring it back from here.
details.openInObsidianTip: Obsidian › Settings › Community plugins, on this plugin: install or enable it there
help.title: Help
help.step.explore.desc: Click a card on Home, or search All. Each card takes you to a list of plugins worth a look: newcomers, fast risers, comebacks after a long silence.
help.step.track.desc: Press ★ on a plugin you like: it gets a note of its own. When a new release ships, Home tells you; your rating, groups and notes stay right there.
help.step.query.desc: Describe what you're looking for, for example: gain(30d) >= 500 AND NOT tracked. Save it as a view and it stays on Home as a card that's always up to date.
home.quickstart.desc: Explore → Track → Write a query: three basic steps, one click each.
help.group.flags.hint: (written alone; NOT in front for the opposite)
help.op.has: contains every word, in any order (spaces and hyphens don't count)  /  doesn't
help.op.in: one of these  /  none of these
help.op.bool: and (a space works too) / or / not
help.op.order: sort (desc: high to low, asc: low to high)
help.op.group: sections: one per value (group, category, primary, tag, intent, lifecycle, status, author); a plugin with several shows under each
help.op.limit: only part of the sorted list: the first 100, or the 101st to the 200th — pick them all and act on them together
help.value.span: a span: days (d), weeks (w), months (m), years (y)
help.value.quoted: a value with spaces, or a plain text search
menu.groupTip: Keep plugins that do the same job together; see them group by group on the Tracked page.
menu.similarTip: See alternatives that do the same job side by side, and pick the best.
menu.readmeOpen: Open the README in your note
menu.readmeOpenTip: The README is saved in your note: read it offline and add your own notes under it.
menu.readmeDownloadTip: Creates the plugin's note and downloads the README into it, so the plugin becomes tracked. To just read it, click an empty spot on the card.
menu.snoozeTip: Takes the plugin off every list for now. It comes back by itself when a new release ships. Changed your mind? Bring it back from the Hidden page.
menu.trackTip: Track: makes a local note with the GitHub README; starts rating, grouping and following its new releases.
menu.untrackTip: Click to stop tracking (your note moves to the trash, so you can bring it back from there)
menu.rateTip: 1–5 stars: remember which ones you love and which ones you dropped.
menu.excludeTip: It won't show in any list. Changed your mind? Bring it back from the Hidden page.
menu.dismissTip: Takes it off Suggested; the plugin stays installed. You can bring it back from the Hidden page.
help.card.title: Get to know a card: what each click does
help.card.star: ★ Track: the plugin gets its note, and you never miss a release again.
help.card.track: 🔔 Track: the plugin gets its note, and you never miss a release again.
help.card.rate: ★ Rate: rest on the star and pick 1–5. Your 4★ and 5★ plugins gather under Tracked › ★ 4+.
help.card.name: The plugin's name: opens its GitHub page.
help.card.desc: 文A EN: click the chip in front of a description and it shows in your language, in place (the chip turns blue). Click again for the original. With Settings › Show translations first (on by default), translated ones already show in your language.
help.card.empty: An empty spot on the card: opens the details window, with the README, downloads and release history.
help.card.details: In the details window the README is already open. 🔔, ★ and ⋯ sit at the top, a right click opens the same menu, and your keyboard shortcuts work there too. A translated README is kept for you, so you pay for it only once; the bottom line shows what it cost.
help.card.menu: ⋯ or a right click: add to a group, find similar plugins, download the README, translate again with another model when a translation reads badly, stop tracking or hide the plugin. Rest on a line and it tells you what it does.
help.card.seen: A plugin you track has a new release? Open its note, or look at its details for 10 seconds: it counts as seen and the badge on Home goes away by itself.
query.field.category: its categories: its home and up to two more
query.field.tag: its tags (a fixed list of about 500)
query.field.intent: new: a new capability, improve: makes an Obsidian feature better, alternative: another take on an existing plugin
query.field.apikey: needs an API key to work (an optional one doesn't count)
query.field.paid: needs a paid service to work (an optional one doesn't count)
query.field.summary: the AI summary of its README
query.field.translated: what's in your language: description, overview
help.group.profile.hint: (read from each plugin's README, refreshed daily)
profile.intent.new.tip: Adds something Obsidian can't do on its own.
profile.intent.improve.tip: Makes one of Obsidian's own features better.
profile.intent.alternative.tip: Another take on what an existing plugin already does: compare them before you choose.
details.primaryTip: Its home category: see the plugins of {name}
home.category.info: The plugins of {category}, the most downloaded first. When a new plugin joins the category, it tells you with “+N new”.
help.card.profile: The details window opens on Overview: what the plugin solves and does, in a few lines; the side column shows what it needs (an API key, a paid service…). Original | your language reads both tabs in your language, and a category or tag lists the plugins like it.
query.unsavedWidget: The query of the “{name}” widget changed.
query.unsavedPage: The query of the “{name}” page changed.
details.overviewNotTranslated: This Overview has no {lang} translation yet.
details.overviewOutdated: The profile changed after this translation.
details.needsNone: No extra account, key or fee needed.
bulk.suggestTip: The AI suggests groups for the first {n} picked; they show under the rows.
bulk.snoozeTip: Comes back with a new release
bulk.what.unrate: Unrated ones stay as they are.
bulk.tr.head: {n} plugins · {lang}
bulk.tr.descSub: in requests of 50; shows in place in the list
bulk.tr.fetchSub: into the cache; into the note when tracked
bulk.tr.readmeSub: one request each; starts after you confirm
bulk.tr.noProfiles: None of the picked plugins has an Overview.
bulk.tr.noNotes: No notes are made for plugins you don't track
help.card.bulk: ☑ Bulk: tick a row's box (Shift for a range). The bar at the bottom tracks, rates, groups or translates them all at once: short descriptions, Overviews, READMEs. AI jobs tell you what they'll take first. Hide for now comes back with a new release; Hide for good comes back from Hidden. Esc clears the selection.
bulk.tr.overBudget: stopped at {cost}: past the estimate you agreed to. The estimate now goes by what these requests cost; run it again to carry on
bulk.tr.tooManyErrors: stopped after {n} failures in a row: {error}
